name: Tombstone: No Mercy

features.name: Justice Spins
features.description: Badges on reels 1 and 5 make wilds sticky.

features.name: Gunslinger Spins
features.description: Ten spins with growing wild multipliers.

review:
A western on a small 2-3-3-3-2 grid, with three-row Outlaw xNudge wilds on reels 2 to 4 gaining +1 per nudge. A Sheriff badge on reel 1 and a Marshal badge on reel 5 give three Justice Spins with sticky wilds.

Three scatters give ten Gunslinger Spins, where the Outlaw wilds build bigger multipliers. Extreme volatility, 16,480x max.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
